lines.text: The extra person in a pair.
I felt like a third wheel.

data.mean: The extra person in a pair.
data.define: A person who feels left out when two others are together.

example.text: I felt like a third wheel.

misuse.text: Don't say 'third wheel' about a car.
misuse.why: It means an extra person in a pair.

publish.title: What does "third wheel" mean?
